decision: Publish exactly one runtime package named @astrale-os/ui
rationale: One supported package vocabulary without forcing high-level source compositions into npm runtime dependencies

decision: Distribute patterns and blocks from the same public repository registry
rationale: Keeps one Astrale UI product while source ownership and dependency cost remain per installed item

decision: Do not publish ui-patterns or ui-blocks runtime packages in V1
rationale: No evidence yet requires independent version or dependency lifecycles

decision: Use semantic internal families and flat public subpaths
rationale: Ownership remains clear without leaking directory taxonomy to consumers

decision: Do not use a generic primitives directory
rationale: The name does not establish a semantic owner or dependency direction

decision: Keep Radix as the V1 behavioral substrate but outside theme and brand contracts
rationale: Superseded before public release by UI-D025 after Base UI became the shadcn default

decision: Treat theme presets as CSS token and stable-slot overrides
rationale: A preset can change complete visual character without a React provider or component fork

decision: Keep reset.css opt-in and exclude Tailwind preflight from theme.css
rationale: Embedding resets in a library stylesheet mutates the host application globally

decision: Move calendar carousel chart combobox form sidebar toast and documentation compositions to pattern families
rationale: They are dependency-rich or composition-shaped and require multiple variants

decision: Absorb attachment bubble marker message and message-scroller into the message pattern family
rationale: They form one conversation responsibility rather than five unrelated package owners

decision: Make blocks controlled compositions with no hidden I/O auth routing or persistence
rationale: Blocks remain off-the-shelf without taking application ownership

decision: Expose astrale ui as a top-level CLI group
rationale: It is the coherent Astrale discovery and installation journey requested by consumers

decision: Delegate registry transformation to an exact shadcn CLI invoked on demand
rationale: Avoids reimplementing registry semantics and adds no shadcn dependency to the installed Astrale CLI

decision: Add no UI dependency peer export or facade to @astrale-os/sdk
rationale: UI selection is an application/tooling concern and the SDK install must remain byte-for-byte unaffected

decision: Integrate generated React projects through an explicit UI scaffold choice after public package qualification
rationale: Generated apps may depend on UI without coupling SDK runtime or non-React variants

decision: Use public GitHub source-registry addresses pinned to an immutable release tag in V1
rationale: Avoids a new registry service while retaining one-SHA source consistency

decision: Generate built registry JSON only as validation and release evidence
rationale: The source registry remains the single registry authority

decision: Use a clean cutover from all six private packages
rationale: Private legacy packages do not justify permanent public compatibility debt

decision: Use Release Please as the sole version authority for the collapsed package
rationale: One package must have one version tag changelog and publication decision

decision: Publish every automated release through GitHub Actions trusted publishing with provenance
rationale: A single human-gated first-package bootstrap is allowed because npm requires the package to exist before trust can be configured; no token fallback is allowed in CI

decision: Ratify the repository and package license before ingesting the final upstream snapshot
rationale: README says MIT while manifests and repository contain no license; this is a legal owner decision

decision: Choose the initial named preset set after the catalog proves each preset across every component state
rationale: Names are illustrative until visual and accessibility evidence prevents shallow preset aliases

decision: Set install tarball CSS and representative bundle budgets from the first lean qualified baseline
rationale: Unmeasured aspirational byte limits are false authority

decision: Own only minimal semantic control glyphs and expose explicit icon slots
rationale: Avoids a general icon-library runtime dependency while keeping product icon character replaceable

decision: Use Base UI 1.7 through the pinned Base/Nova shadcn intake as the internal behavioral substrate
rationale: The public contract is not released yet and Base UI now provides the recommended broader open-part foundation

decision: Require public class style render and part-level override access across runtime patterns and blocks
rationale: Base UI philosophy must survive Astrale wrappers and installed source must be host-customizable
